title: 第1章第2章 你想报仇我也想报仇啊
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
“沉睡万年期限已满，恭喜宿主获得沉睡万年奖励！”
系统声音在陈长生脑中响起。
陈长生醒来，睁开闭了万年的双眼，结束万年沉睡。
系统奖励到位。
他得到了沉睡万年的奖励！
没有上限的无敌修为，数不尽的帝兵、帝药、帝术等！
砰！
万年不腐的金丝楠木棺材，厚重棺材盖打开。
陈长生走了出来。
沉睡万年，他并不苍老，非常年轻，剑眉星目，英俊帅气。
“万年一梦啊…”
他目光如星空般深邃，英俊的脸上露出回忆之色。
他是穿越者。
万年前从蓝星穿越而来。
刚穿越时，他并未开启系统。
在百年过后，他才开启了系统，得到了长生系统。
系统告诉他，沉睡万年就可无敌。
他便带着系统给他的金丝楠木棺材，来到这里沉睡。
如今，万年期限已满，他也真正的无敌了。
他收起金丝楠木棺材。

走出封死的山洞。
外面，阳光正好，一缕温煦阳光照在陈长生脸上。
他有种恍如隔世的感觉。
吼！
突然，一道震天彻地的吼叫声响起，天摇地颤，恐怖凶煞气若洪水决堤般向他袭来。
“擅闯吾之禁地者，死！”
一头可怕的凶兽出现，带着冰冷的声音，遮天蔽日。
阳光没了！
大地陷入一片灰暗。
凶兽长有九个脑袋，形似狮子，浑身毛发金黄璀璨，凶威迫世！
这是九头狮！
禁地之主。
一头触碰到帝境的准帝兽。
“乖。”
陈长生面色平静，一手伸出。
霎那间，有无穷浩瀚之力，携带无上秩序法则，向九头狮压去。
content_en:
"The period of ten thousand years of sleep has expired. Congratulations to the host for receiving the reward of ten thousand years of sleep!"
The system voice sounded in Chen Changsheng's mind.
Chen Changsheng woke up, opened his eyes that had been closed for ten thousand years, and ended his ten thousand years of sleep.
System rewards are in place.
He was rewarded with sleeping for thousands of years!
Unlimited invincible cultivation, countless imperial weapons, imperial medicines, imperial arts, etc.!
Bang!
The golden nanmu coffin, which lasts for thousands of years, has a thick coffin lid opened.
Chen Changsheng walked out.
After sleeping for thousands of years, he is not old, but very young, with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, handsome and handsome.
"It's a dream that lasts forever..."
His eyes were as deep as the stars, and his handsome face showed the color of memories.
He is a time traveler.
Traveled from Blue Star thousands of years ago.
When he first traveled through time, he did not turn on the system.
Only after a hundred years did he activate the system and obtain the immortality system.
The system told him that he could become invincible by sleeping for ten thousand years.
He took the golden nanmu coffin given to him by the system and came here to sleep.
Now, the ten thousand year period has expired, and he is truly invincible.
He put away the golden nanmu coffin.
Get out of the sealed cave.
Outside, the sun was shining just right, and a ray of warm sunshine shone on Chen Changsheng's face.
He felt like he was in another world.
roar!
Suddenly, a roar that shook the heavens and the earth rang out, the earth shook, and the terrifying and evil energy rushed toward him like a flood bursting through a bank.
"Those who trespass on my forbidden land will die!"
A terrifying ferocious beast appeared, with a cold voice, covering the sky and the sun.
The sun is gone!
The earth fell into darkness.
The ferocious beast has nine heads, looks like a lion, and has golden hair all over its body. It is menacing and menacing!
This is a nine-headed lion!
Lord of the Forbidden Land.
A quasi-emperor beast that has touched the imperial realm.
"Be good."
Chen Changsheng looked calm and stretched out his hand.
In an instant, there was infinite power, carrying the laws of supreme order, pressing towards the nine-headed lion.
